title: Randomized Assessment of SAPIEN 3 Ultra and SAPIEN 3 Ultra RESILIA Valve 23 in Patients With Severe Aortic Stenosis
official: Randomized Assessment of SAPIEN 3 Ultra and SAPIEN 3 Ultra RESILIA Valve 23 in Patients With Severe Aortic Stenosis: Invasive Hemodynamic and Clinical Evaluation
summary:
The goal of this clinical trial is to compare two transcatheter heart valves, the SAPIEN 3 Ultra RESILIA and the SAPIEN 3 Ultra, in adults with symptomatic severe aortic stenosis (narrowing of the aortic valve) who are undergoing transcatheter aortic valve replacement (TAVR) with a 23 mm valve.

The main question it aims to answer is:

* Does the SAPIEN 3 Ultra RESILIA valve allow blood to flow more easily through the valve than the SAPIEN 3 Ultra valve after TAVR?

Researchers will compare participants who receive the SAPIEN 3 Ultra RESILIA valve with those who receive the SAPIEN 3 Ultra valve to see if there are differences in how blood flows through the valves after implantation.

Participants will be randomly assigned to receive either the SAPIEN 3 Ultra RESILIA or SAPIEN 3 Ultra valve during their clinically indicated TAVR procedure.

interventions.name: SAPIEN 3 Ultra RESILIA Transcatheter Heart Valve (23 mm)
SAPIEN 3 Ultra Transcatheter Heart Valve (23 mm)

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Subject is at least 18 years of age.
* Symptomatic severe aortic stenosis.
* Subject is judged by the institutional heart team to be appropriate for transcatheter aortic valve replacement.
* Subject has a life expectancy ≥1 year.
* Aortic annulus size is suitable for 23mm SAPIEN 3 Ultra and SAPIEN 3 Ultra RESILIA valves
* Subject is eligible for treatment with both the 23 mm SAPIEN 3 Ultra and SAPIEN 3 Ultra RESILIA valves, in accordance with the Instructions for Use.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Ongoing sepsis, including active endocarditis.
* Other medical, social, or psychological conditions that, in the opinion of the Investigator, preclude the subject from providing informed consent.
* Pregnancy or intent to become pregnant within the next 12 months.
* Contraindicated for treatment with the Edwards SAPIEN 3 Ultra and SAPIEN 3 Ultra RESILIA THV Systems in accordance with the Instructions for Use.
